basis: Complement-mediated renal TMA causes hemolysis and thrombocytopenia; vascular endothelial injury and microvascular thrombosis are defining, independent of secondary hypertension.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: endothelial injury and capillary thrombosis are defining disease processes; hypertension alone is not the justification.

basis: Interstitial keratitis is generally immune-mediated corneal stromal inflammation, often triggered by infection, causing scarring and visual impairment.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: the characteristic stromal inflammation is generally immune-mediated, including infection-triggered forms.

basis: Immunodeficiency with defining ectodermal dysplasia in ~70-80%; dental developmental defects affect >30%. Osteopetrosis is confined to a minority subtype.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: ectodermal dysplasia is a named, defining component affecting most (~70-80%), with impaired sweating and hair development.

basis: Septal defects 3/5 and 2/5; sensorineural hearing loss 2/4; congenital hypothyroidism 1/3. Ocular and airway anomalies omitted under cap; all estimates use small subsets.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: congenital hypothyroidism in 1/3 meets the supplied frequency threshold, although the denominator is small.

basis: Isolated thymic positional anomaly; the thymus has no anatomical axis here, and ectopia does not establish blood-cell disease, immunodeficiency or endocrine dysfunction.

decisions.haematologic: none: thymic ectopia is not a disease of blood cells, marrow or coagulation; a broad hematologic ancestor does not establish this axis.

basis: Apical lung carcinoma commonly directly invades brachial plexus or sympathetic nerves (~30-50%), producing neurologic dysfunction. Bone invasion frequency is uncertain.

decisions.neurologic: involved: direct brachial plexus or sympathetic nerve invasion causes neurologic dysfunction in roughly 30-50%; pain alone would not qualify.

basis: Bone or soft connective-tissue tumor; intrinsic FGF23 secretion causes sustained phosphate wasting in most (>80%). Separate downstream osteomalacia adds no axis; phosphaturia is not renal damage.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: sustained FGF23-mediated phosphate wasting occurs in most (>80%) and is intrinsic tumor activity; separately diagnosed osteomalacia is not the justification.

basis: Fibrinolytic protein deficiency causes damaging mucosal membranes: ocular disease 80-99%, gingival disease 30-79%. Hydrocephalus generally affects <15%, despite a selected 2/2 series.

decisions.neurologic: none: hydrocephalus generally occurs in <15%; the selected 2/2 report does not represent its frequency across this disease.

basis: Acute mucopurulent cervicitis is predominantly infectious; the cervix itself is outside the anatomical axes. Noninfectious cases are a minority.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: infection is the usual cause of acute mucopurulent cervicitis and applies across most patients, despite noninfectious exceptions.

basis: Immune-mediated skeletal muscle disease; interstitial lung disease causes direct pulmonary damage in approximately 30-40% overall, with substantial subtype variation.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: interstitial lung disease affects approximately 30-40% across major idiopathic inflammatory myopathy cohorts, meeting the threshold despite subtype variation.
